evals.prompt: Design the core gameplay loop and juiciness feedback mechanics for a retro 2D space miner arcade game.
evals.expected_output: A game design document detailing the core loop (Input -> Physics -> Feedback -> Outcome), HUD layout, and juiciness elements.
assertions: Defines clear core gameplay loop (Input -> Physics Update -> Feedback -> Outcome)
Includes specific juiciness embellishments (e.g. screen shake, particle bursts, floating score popups)
Specifies transparent HUD indicators for vital state (fuel, cargo, hull integrity)
Mandates human-in-the-loop playability with responsive controls

evals.prompt: Balance the difficulty progression curve and control mechanics for an obstacle course drone simulation.
evals.expected_output: A progressive difficulty specification balancing challenge, feedback cues, and control sensitivity.
assertions: Defines a progressive difficulty curve rather than abrupt spikes
Ensures cause-and-effect transparency between user inputs and physics response
Includes visual indicators for danger zones and proximity warnings
Structures design concepts into actionable stories for engineering backlog
